relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment of mouse macrophages with TRPV1 inhibitor AMG9810 or CPZ significantly inhibited the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-6, IL-1β and IL-18, as well as cyclooxygenase 2 (COX-2)

key_findings: Review: TRPV1 regulates T cells, macrophages and dendritic cells and drives IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-8, IL-17 and TNF-alpha production in RA
TRPV1 is proposed as a target for RA pain, angiogenesis and cartilage destruction
